==Instructions==
Linking to a current Holonet article:
:<pre><nowiki>{{Holonet|category|subject|text|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></pre>
Note that care must be taken to avoid an incorrect link.

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|category}} found in the URL immediately after <code><nowiki>https://www.swtor.com/holonet/</nowiki></code> and before the subsequent <code><nowiki>/</nowiki></code>. For example, it would be <mark>allegiances</mark> as highlighted in the following URL: <code><nowiki>https://www.swtor.com/holonet/</nowiki></code><mark>allegiances</mark>/galactic-republic.
*{{Para|subject}} found in the last part of the URL after <code><nowiki>https://www.swtor.com/holonet/[category]/</nowiki></code>. For example, it would be <mark>galactic-republic</mark> as highlighted in the following URL: <code><nowiki>https://www.swtor.com/holonet/allegiances/</nowiki></code><mark>galactic-republic</mark>.
*{{Para|text}} The formatted text to display.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below. Note: the default values for dates are centralized at [[Module:ArchiveAccess/{{ROOTPAGENAMEE}}]]. This template will use the default value when omitting <code>archivedate</code> or <code>archiveurl</code>, but either can be provided to override the default value.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|nolive}} Use <code>nolive=1</code> if the original content is no longer available.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{Holonet|allegiances|sith-empire|The Sith Empire}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Holonet|allegiances|sith-empire|The Sith Empire}}
